title: Godot output sometimes misses logs before `quit()`, but console shows all output
body:
### Tested versions

The output being cut off in godot vs console happens in:
v4.4.beta4.official [93d270693]
v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]
v4.0.stable.official [92bee43ad]

does not happen on 3.6:
v3.6.stable.official [de2f0f147]

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta4 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 9 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7242) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-11900K @ 3.50GHz (16 threads)

### Issue description

I think it is due to the time needed to save the file, but occasionally when saving a file, it will not show the full print output in the godot window.

It will show the output in the console, but if you are not running the console version you will think it never got to those steps in the code, as I did at first.

As for the crash, it might be because the file of "save.txt" was not there and it was trying to do something with the generation, as the console showed, but why it crashed on running it again after that I am not sure. That will have to be tested later. Here is the output from that crash console:
